opening.argument: The opening title presents an Apple Tech Support call as a skit, and the closing message explicitly calls it one of the creators’ “terrible skits.” The exchange does mention a free lottery, asks for a first and last name, and references FUNRUN dot com. But the caller questions whether this is really Apple tech support and leaves. The speaker also describes arranging for a friend to take part and finds the situation hilarious. Taken together, those details support a comedic performance, not an attempt by the creators to solicit the viewer.
